decisions.decision: Use an ESM Express server as the runtime entry point.
consequences: Routes are default-exported Express routers.
Runtime path resolution uses fileURLToPath(import.meta.url).

decisions.decision: Call Suno APIs from Express route handlers instead of directly from the browser.
consequences: The client calls /api/playlist endpoints.
Server-side code handles pagination and profile scraping behavior.

decisions.decision: The active root download flow serves complete playlists as ZIP files.
consequences: Root routes/download.js has individual song routes removed.
web-version/routes/download.js still contains legacy single-song support.

decisions.decision: Persist settings in browser localStorage and synchronize them to Express sessions.
consequences: Settings survive browser refreshes through localStorage.
Server-side settings are per-session and resettable via DELETE /api/settings.

decisions.decision: Prefer checked-in prebuilt public assets before building or serving client/dist.
consequences: Replit deployments can run without a successful client build.
server.js scans multiple possible static asset locations.

decisions.decision: Use Vite for the client and proxy /api to the Express server during development.
consequences: Frontend dev server runs on port 5000.
Backend API remains on port 3000.

decisions.decision: Render a single Adsterra banner through a client-side script component.
consequences: The banner key is read from VITE_ADSTERRA_UNIT_KEY.
AdSlot reserves fixed layout height for CLS stability and assumes one mounted instance.
Multiple instances would overwrite window.atOptions — documented inline as a constraint.

decisions.decision: Use CSS custom properties (--bg-primary, --accent, etc.) as the single theming mechanism across components, p5.js sketch, and Mantine inline styles.
consequences: Dark/light mode switching works by toggling CSS classes on document root.
p5.js sketch reads getComputedStyle(document.documentElement) to pick colors.
Mantine component styles reference var(--bg-card) and var(--accent) in style prop.

decisions.decision: Use p5.js for the animated waveform background with a custom React hook (useP5) instead of a canvas element managed in a useEffect.
consequences: p5 instance lifecycle is fully managed by useP5, including React Strict Mode double-mount safety.
Sketch is seeded for deterministic initial render (seed=42 default).
Canvas resizes on window resize via p5 windowResized.

decisions.decision: Embed all SEO meta (OG, Twitter Card, JSON-LD), Google AdSense, and Google Fonts in public/index.html rather than in the React app.
consequences: SEO tags are present in the served HTML without JS execution.
AdSense loads as a blocking script from public/index.html — present regardless of client build.
Changes to SEO or ad config require updating public/index.html and rebuilding the deployment.

decisions.decision: Keep web-version as a duplicate/legacy implementation alongside the active root app.
consequences: Some endpoints and client dependencies differ between root and web-version.
web-version/package.json has its own qs/on-headers security overrides.
Codebase intelligence must distinguish root active files from web-version files.

decisions.decision: Remove multer from root package.json dependencies.
consequences: multer is still present in web-version as it has a different package tree.
No multipart form handling in active root server.
